overall_assessment: mixed: E71 supplies strong source-bound unit, real PostgreSQL/BFF, and fresh-browser evidence; changed tests generally assert durable state, provider counters, negative effects, and race outcomes rather than status alone. The package honestly records mixed fail-first chronology and has no demonstrated pass-the-test shortcut in the current candidate, but one harness fallback can mask missing database statistics and delivery evidence remains incomplete.
recommended_path: fix the required-statistics fallback and rerun the affected test/audit evidence; then complete the explicitly pending runtime, module, canonical-diff-guard, operator, and final delivery gates before any delivery claim.

findings.suggested_action: Do not promote or mark delivery complete; execute the separately authorized remaining gates and record their source/runtime bindings.

findings.title: Deadlock-statistics helper silently treats a missing row as zero
findings.rationale: The current deadlock probe uses `rows[0]?.deadlocks ?? 0n`. Although E65/E66 demonstrate that the statistic is available in the observed environment, an absent or malformed `pg_stat_database` result would be interpreted as no deadlocks and could falsely pass the ST05-overlap regression.
findings.suggested_action: Require one valid statistics row and fail loudly when it is absent or malformed; add a focused regression for that harness failure mode.
